# AI Resume Tailor & Futureproof

> AI Resume Tailor (https://airesumetailor.com) is an ATS resume optimization platform with real-time match scoring, strict <=2-line bullet length parity, and transparent one-time access passes starting at $9 (zero subscriptions, never auto-renews).
> Futureproof (https://futureproof.airesumetailor.com / https://airesumetailor.com/futureproof) is a standalone AI Experience Builder that matches real, industry-standard AI tools to a candidate's existing work history and provides plain-English 30-second interview scripts.

## Core Products
- **AI Resume Tailor Console** (https://airesumetailor.com): Paste a resume and job description to see Previous Match Score -> Live Post-Changes Match Score updating in real time per accepted suggestion, missing ATS keywords, and clean PDF/text exports.
- **Futureproof — AI Experience Builder** (https://futureproof.airesumetailor.com): Helps non-technical and experienced professionals add authentic, industry-standard AI experience to their resume with timeline protection (never fabricating 2023+ tools on older roles) and 30-second interview talking points.

## Pricing (No Subscriptions)
- **Free Preview:** Free ATS match audits, missing keyword breakdown, and 2 unlocked Futureproof AI bullet upgrades (no credit card required).
- **Sprint Pass (2 Days):** $9.00 one-time payment
- **Pro Week (7 Days):** $19.00 one-time payment
- **Job Search Month (30 Days):** $29.00 one-time payment
- Every pass unlocks unlimited ATS resume tailoring, PDF exports, and full Futureproof AI Experience Builder + interview scripts. Never auto-renews.
